notes.title: Not For Broadcast VR Patch 2 Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Broadcasters!

We’ve just pushed live an update that fixes a few issues. Here are the latest patch notes:

[list]
[*] "Remote interactions" accessibility option is added for sitting/limited space gameplay
[*] Final broadcast bug was fixed (footage was playing regardless if player wanted it to play or not)
[*] Players now get automatically re-centered when a new scene starts
[*] Other minor fixes and improvements
[/list]
Thank you for your continued support and all the feedback you provide!

Cheers,

NotGames Team

notes.title: Patch 1 is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Broadcasters![/h3]

[h3]Thank you so much for your feedback in these past few weeks - it’s been invaluable in investigating the issues with Not For Broadcast VR. We’ve just pushed live a patch that fixes a wide array of concerns you’ve raised through bug reports. Here are the patch notes for this update![/h3]

[h2][list]
[*] WMR headsets are now supported
[*] Decreased the difficulty and refined the Interference minigame controls
[*] Fixed the bug in “Heatwave” episode, where the fan was not cooling the bulbs properly
[*] Fixed the bugs with UI pointer tool
[*] Refined VR interactions
[*] Fixed various bugs occuring throughout the episodes
[/list][/h2]

[h3]Once again, thank you [b]SO MUCH[/b] for your continued support and the feedback you provide - we’re hoping the Not For Broadcast VR experience will be much more pleasant now![/h3]

Cheers,

NotGames Team
